notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Prepared Defenses, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Secret Plans, Imperial Arrest Order ('IAO'), Epic Duel and Mobilization Points, plus the Objective listed under 'Objectives (1)'; they count toward the 60. starting.effect is Visage Of The Emperor because the Objective deploys it (the strategy says he also starts IAO, Secret Plans and Mobilization Points).
Visage Of The Emperor is posted once in the starting section and x2 under Effects (3 copies); Vader's Obsession is posted twice under Interrupts (x1 and x2, 3 copies). Both kept as posted.
The Starships header says (3) but four are listed; the full list totals 60 as posted.

Posted 'Tatooine DB', 'Cloud City DB' and 'Endor DB' dested the Dark docking bays Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark), Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) and Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark); 'IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order.

Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; '4-LOM w/ gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Boba Fett w/ Blaster' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Dengar w/ Blaster' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Iggy w/ Gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Zuckuss/Dengar/Fett in Ship' the Mist Hunter, Punishing One and Slave I combo starships.
'DS Grabber' is kept as written (UNKNOWN): the grabber is not named.
Secret Plans is an Effect in 2001 (not a Defensive Shield).
The strategy says the deck went 10-3 in tournament play (no event named).
Credited to the existing page Michael Robinson (same name and DeckTech handle Bobafett465); his later 'Fettman's Huntdown Re-re-released' (13 April 2001) is a different list.
